parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstanceInfo](~~140857~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: OrderWay
parameters.description:
The sorting order. Valid values:

-  **asc**: ascending order.
- **desc**: descending order.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **5**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The sensitive data type. Valid values:

- **request**: sensitive data in requests.
- **response**: sensitive data in responses.
